## ⭐ Why this one card ends the class

Verbatim from triage: 「⭐ 它是这处腐烂的第三个实例,**也是最后一个还活着的**(前两处 objectui#7998 已在 README 里更正)⇒ **关掉它就结束这一类**,⛔ 不是又开一张同族卡。」

⇒ the objectui#7998 / PR objectui#9811 pair corrected two README claims about this same flag. This third one survived **because it lives in source rather than in the documents that were swept**. ⚠️ Do ⛔ not file a fourth same-family card; if you find one, that is a finding to report, not a card to open.

## ⛔ And ⛔ do NOT downgrade it in your own head because it is one comment line

Triage anticipated exactly that: 「⭐ ⛔ **不因为「只是一行注释」降到 p3** —— 判据不是**字数**,是**作者照它写会得到一个静默无效的键**。」

## The measurement to re-take, with the control that makes it a reading

The filing seat re-ran the lane's own positive control before filing, ⛔ rather than inheriting the dev's. Re-take both on a freshly fetched `origin/main` and report the ref and UTC time:

| probe | what it must show |
|:--|:--|
| ⭐ **CONTROL** — `options.showReferenceRail` in this same file | **hits** ⇒ the query fires and the live option is where the docblock's first sentence says it is |
| **SUBJECT** — any `detail.`-scoped rail key across `packages/`, excluding CHANGELOGs | the **only** hit is `:159`'s docblock line |

⚠️ The control is what makes the subject row a **reading** rather than a dead grep. ⛔ Do not report the subject's count without it.

## The repair

Correct the parenthetical so it names the live route only, and ⛔ nothing else in the docblock — its first sentence and the 「OFF by default / fans out a collection query per related list」 rationale are **true** and load-bearing; ⛔ do not rewrite them. ⚠️ A pin is owed: nothing today stops that sentence rotting back, and this is the **third** instance of the same rot. Add one that fails if a `detail.`-scoped rail key reappears in this package's source.

## ⛔ Out of scope

⛔ `packages/plugin-detail/README.md` — objectui#7998 already corrected it and PR objectui#9811 landed that; ⛔ and it is inside seat 1's in-flight objectui#8114 surface. ⛔ The retired objectDef reader itself — it is gone under ADR-0085, ⛔ nothing to remove. ⛔ `hideReferenceRail` / `hideRelatedTab` unless the subject probe shows them still taught in source, in which case **report** before touching.

## Serial constraints cleared, read at 2026-09-18T11:14Z

⚠️ Seat 1's in-flight objectui#8114 is in **this same package**: its claim declares `packages/plugin-detail/README.md` (the tab example), with `DetailTabs.tsx` and `index.tsx` **read-only**. ⇒ ⛔ no file collision with `src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`, but you are a changeset neighbour in `@object-ui/plugin-detail`. ⛔ Do not touch that README.

## Reading discipline

Every zero needs a same-subject control firing in the same command. Resolve refs before grepping (`git cat-file -t "$REF" >/dev/null || exit 1`). ⛔ Print LINES, never a bare count. ⚠️ Two shapes this lane has measured and that both bite on docblock work: a code-shaped pattern gives a **false zero or a false count** against non-code text; and ⭐ **a source-text assertion over a file that DOCUMENTS the construct it asserts on will pass off the comment** — measured in objectui#7181's repair, invisible to the assertion's own result, caught only by ablation. ⚠️ That second one is directly in your path: the pin you add reads a file whose docblock is the subject. **Strip whole-line comments when asserting on code, and assert on the comment only where the comment IS the subject** — and ablate to prove each direction can fail.
